architecture.mechanism: cathodic polarization at -0.95 VCSE inhibits SRB biofilm formation and promotes calcareous deposit formation, improving corrosion protection for small coating defects

architecture.expected_effect: reduced current drain from coating holidays, stabilized pipe-to-soil potential at -0.85 V or better, and suppressed microbial activity at defect sites
architecture.falsification_test: install temporary sacrificial anodes at the far ends, measure pipe-to-soil potential and current demand over 30 days; verify biofilm presence via ultrasonic testing or microbial sampling at defect sites before/after intervention
